summary: The Spark Developer builds high-performance data processing applications using Apache Spark for batch and real-time analytics.
responsibilities: Develop Spark applications using Spark Core, Spark SQL, and Spark Streaming
Optimize Spark jobs for performance and scalability
Work with large datasets in distributed environments
Integrate Spark with Hadoop and cloud platforms
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers

education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field

skills_required.name: Strong Scala, Python (PySpark), or Java skills
In-depth knowledge of Apache Spark internals
Experience with Hadoop and distributed storage
